What we do:

- book calls straight in your calender

We already helped 40+ spaces (cant name them, NDA) get 3x more leads. Our outsourced SDR team costs a fraction of one hire.

mails.subject: Unclaimed funds in your favour
mails.body:
Dear Beneficiary,

My name is Adewale Okonkwo, a claims officer at Trust Claims Office. A deceased client left unclaimed funds of 4,200,000 EUR and records show no next of kin.

I propose that we present you as the beneficiary. You will receive 40 percent of the total sum, I take 60 percent for the legal process.

This transaction is risk free and confidential. To start, reply with your full name, address and bank account number.

Please treat this as urgent.

Regards,
Adewale Okonkwo

mails.subject: Custom software development for your business
mails.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to introduce CloudCrafters Solutions, a software development company with over 12 years of experience.

We build custom web applications, mobile apps and internal tools for small and medium businesses. Our team of 60 engineers works in your time zone and follows agile methods.

Our services include:
- Web and mobile app development
- UI and UX design
- Cloud migration and DevOps
- Dedicated development teams on a monthly basis

We believe that your organisation could benefit from a reliable technology partner. Many of our clients reduced development costs by up to 50 percent compared with local hiring.

We would be happy to prepare a free estimate based on your requirements. Please let me know a convenient time for a 15 minute introductory call.

I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards,
Priya Nandakumar
Business Development Manager
CloudCrafters Solutions

mails.subject: Guest post on your blog: 250 EUR per placement
mails.body:
Hello,

My name is Elliot and I work for LinkForge, a link building service. I found your website while researching coworking and startup blogs.

We would like to buy a guest post slot on your site. We pay 250 EUR per article, and we can write the article ourselves in good English. It would include two dofollow links to our clients' websites.

Besides this, we also sell high authority backlinks to sites like yours. Our packages:
- Starter: 10 backlinks for 390 EUR
- Growth: 30 backlinks for 990 EUR
- Pro: 80 backlinks for 2.100 EUR

All links come from real sites, no spam, we promise. Past clients saw their Google rankings go up in 30 days.

If you are interested in either option, just reply to this email and I send you the topic list and the payment details.

Thank you,
Elliot Barnaby
LinkForge SEO
mails.justification: SEO and paid backlink offer from a stranger, never requested by the space.
